why: All three checks confirm the finding; I could not refute it. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM. curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline.md gives a 1113-line page; the sentence is character-for-character line 1017 under '## Subagent status lines'. Reading the WHOLE line, its second sentence reinforces rather than reverses: 'Use it to replace the default `name - description - token count` row with your own formatting.' The rest of the section corroborates every element of the claim - :1029 'receives all visible subagent rows as a single JSON object on stdin ... a `columns` field with the usable row width, and a `tasks` array. Each task has `id`, `name`, `type`, `status`, `description`, `label`, `startTime`, `model`, `effort`, `contextWindowSize`, `tokenCount`, `tokenSamples`, and `cwd`.'; :1034 'Write one JSON line to stdout per row you want to override, in the form {"id": "<task id>", "content": "<row body>"}'; :1036 'Plugins can ship a default `subagentStatusLine` in their settings.json.' The only nuance the claim omits is harmless version gating (`model`/`contextWindowSize` need v2.1.205, `effort` needs v2.1.214). (2) OUR STATE. Absence re-verified with -a as required: `grep -rain subagentStatusLine .` excluding node_modules/.git/.references returns hits ONLY inside the sweep's own docs (docs/superpowers/specs/data/*.json and the divergence tables) - zero source hits in any .ts/.tsx/.js/.json under packages/, apps/ or scripts/. The plugin-shipped-default half is independently dead too: packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 carries { externalKind: 'settings', field: 'settings', defaultPath: 'settings.json' } in CLAUDE_RETAINED_SURFACE_FIELDS, and addClaudeRetainedSurfaceDeferrals (:2278-2317) only existsSync-checks the file and pushes `plugin.deferred.claude_settings`; that row has no `refusal`, so a Claude plugin shipping a subagentStatusLine default installs with a plain success toast and does nothing (same mechanism as f053). (3) ONE LAYER UP AND DOWN. Sibling-subsystem check: the ONLY `statusLine` identifier in fork source is an unrelated local in packages/shared/src/sessions/storage.ts:901-902 parsing a markdown '**Status:**' line - the finding does not confuse the two, and no sibling subsystem implements the surface under another name. Consequence check, run separately from the identifier: the row this would customize genuinely exists - apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/AgentPanel.tsx (309 lines) renders SubagentCard.tsx, whose AgentRow (:88-122) draws exactly the documented row shape (agent.label, agent.agentType, status, elapsed, phase, formatTokens(totalTokens) with an in/out breakdown), and nothing anywhere lets a user or a plugin replace that body. Nothing upstream honours the setting by another route. Not one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (SEATBELT wildcard, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, listSessionSummaries). Not a deliberate product difference of the documented kind either: it has nothing to do with the dropped Claude/ChatGPT subscription flows, the corporate gateway or the rebrand, and importing Claude plugin bundles is a first-class supported surface here. What DOES need recording is that the gap is already known and deliberately un-rowed rather than newly discovered - see correctedState.
correctedState: Confirmed as stated, with two additions and no reversal. (a) NOT A NEW FINDING - it is already triaged in the source of truth: 2026-07-25-nessy-claude-parity-audit.md:1720 lists 'keybindings, statusline, deep links (claude-cli://)' under '**Minor, no row, listed for completeness**', and 2026-07-31-claude-coverage-map.md row 46 already verdicts the whole page RED ('1 sovpadenie, poverhnosti net'). Important: statusline sits in the audit's 'minor' bucket, NOT in the adjacent 'Explicitly judged inapplicable' bucket (which covers Anthropic-hosted infrastructure only), so no inapplicability ruling exists and the gap stands - it is simply below the bar for a parity row. (b) SHARPER STATE. Precise citations: no source hit for the identifier anywhere; the row it would customize is AgentRow in apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/SubagentCard.tsx:88-122, hosted by AgentPanel.tsx; the plugin-shipped-default path dies at packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 as a silent `plugin.deferred.claude_settings` with no author diagnostic (overlaps f053, which owns that half). One shape caveat worth carrying if this is ever scoped: the documented contract is terminal-shaped - `columns` is the usable row width in characters and `content` is 'rendered as-is, including ANSI colors and OSC 8 hyperlinks' - which does not transfer literally to an Electron React panel, and apps/cli has no subagent row rendering at all (only a comment at index.ts:479), so there is currently no surface in this fork where the contract would land as written.
